scope: Supplementary WebKit behavior and native-window visual verification

checks: Both physical hinges change with scrolling and reverse to their initial angles
Introductory folding stays inside the visible stage
Every reading hold has a flat active panel, framed content and text at least 12 rendered pixels high
Normal reading mode has no horizontal overflow
behavior.mobileInput: Programmatic document scrolling; Playwright does not support mouse-wheel input in mobile WebKit

nativeWindow.verifiedBy: Root agent using Cua to inspect the live headful Playwright window
states: Unfolded three-panel flyer reached with native wheel input
Cash receipt with normally oriented text and amounts

protocolScreenshots.finding: The screenshot API paints hidden backfaces as mirrored content. Native-window rendering is correct. An independent two-face card reproduces the same capture defect without application CSS or GSAP.

warnings.detail: One WebKit warning per viewport reported that the preloaded font was not used within a few seconds. These were warnings, not browser errors.

relationshipToChromium: Separate supplementary evidence; this does not represent the complete 19-test Chromium suite running in WebKit.
